scope: Independent visual annotations of the new foot-v5 runtime before color correction. Sparse material witnesses are checks; the cap boundary is an explicit algorithm input. No pose or color approval is implied.

calibration.measurement: Per-channel median of the fixed 3x3 patch. Visually selected interior of the near calf, away from outline, calf shadow and drawn hair marks.

cap.coordinate_convention: Protect pixel (x,y) above the linearly interpolated boundary when y+0.5 < boundary(x+0.5). Raster is row-major uint8, 255 protected and 0 elsewhere.
cap.method: Freshly inspected the foot-v5 raw and exported cap. Its crown, band and brim fit the same sloped geometry, including a narrow hair/ink margin. The raster was rebuilt for this input. Every material pixel and region expectation below was sampled again from foot-v5, not inherited.
cap.rejected_alternative: A flat top22-row exclusion would cover visible ear/temple skin. New input pixel[18,20] is RGBA[255, 143, 87, 254] and[18,21] is[255, 148, 90, 254]. Both remain outside this polygon.

limitations: These seven points and three 3x3 regions do not exhaustively segment every material. The cap boundary is a conservative visual exclusion; it is not independent proof of the color classifier. Skin targets and correction functions are chosen and verified separately.
